app_name: KingDesign Shoe Company App Builder Project

brand_identity.hero_visual: Gold crown icon with K-D1 obsidian sneaker silhouette

prompts.master_app_builder_prompt: Build a high-end e-commerce app for KingDesign Shoe Company...
prompts.app_publishing_final_prompt: Prepare the KingDesign app for final deployment...

visual_timeline.0_2_seconds: Pitch-black background. A raw, structural concrete floor catches a dim downlight. A heavy mechanical thud echoes as a giant shadow of a geometric crown falls over the scene.
visual_timeline.2_4_seconds: A gold pulse ripple travels across the screen. From the dark, the sharp, glassmorphic structure of the K-D1 sneaker silhouette glints in the light for a microsecond.
visual_timeline.4_5_seconds: The sneaker vanishes into a crisp, pure-gold vector crown icon that snaps to the center of the screen, followed by the text 'KINGDESIGN' fading in below it using ultra-bold brutalist typography. The interface instantly slides up seamlessly into the Home feed.

five_second_splash_intro_script.audio_profile: A sub-bass boom that vibrates the phone (haptic trigger), shifting into a mechanical latch sound, ending with a clean, luxury ambient shimmer.
